# font-kku (vendored)

Copied from font-kku commit `038faa0` (MIT, see `LICENSE`): the browser runtime and its
base CSS, every font in `profiles/`, and the add-ons `looks` (decoration classes),
`motion` (jamo animations) and `fx` (typing, scatter, magnet, shuffle).
Load with `<script src="/vendor/font-kku/font-kku.js" data-fonts="…" data-addons="…">`.
Update by copying the same files from a newer commit.
